description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 20.11.2023 to 26.11.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification. While it mentions a government official (P. B. S. C. Nonis, Director General of Customs), this is only in the context of exercising statutory authority rather than constituting a personnel appointment or government restructuring.
